decision: The competitor (Aston Martin Cognizant F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Document 26 Date 10 September 2021 Time 20:18 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 18, 19) and heard from the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the
fact: Car 5 was released into the path of Car 44.
offence: Breach of Art 28.13 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. Several cars were released into the pit lane at the same time. The driver of Car 5 was released by his team, but at the same time the team's other car was also being released. This caused Car 5 to move towards the fast lane when Car 44 was passing and Car 44 had to take avoiding action to avoid an incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Aston Martin Pit Lane Incident
